description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” visually compares the performance of four different methods in terms of recall at the top 10 recommendations, likely within the context of conversation recommendation using a generative reward model and simulated user, as referenced in the associated paper. The vertical y-axis represents the Recall@10 metric, scaled from 0.1 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1, while the horizontal x-axis lists the four methods: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking.” The “Ours” method, represented by a brown bar, achieves the highest recall at approximately 0.35. The “- critiquing” method, shown in dark teal, follows with a recall of about 0.29. The “- scoring” variant, also in dark teal, performs the worst at roughly 0.17, while “- ranking” achieves approximately 0.23. The chart suggests that the full proposed method (“Ours”) significantly outperforms its ablated versions, particularly when critiquing or scoring components are removed, with the “- scoring” variant showing the most substantial drop in performance. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in a fixed order, with “Ours” emphasized by its distinct color and highest position.
